instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the design reflects an elegant, warm, high-end Italian cookbook style (Playfair Display for titles, Sage Green #5B7065 & Terracotta #D98A6C accents, Cream #F7F4EF background).
All UI texts MUST be in natural Italian as specified in the problem statement.
Implement LocalStorage persistence for Favorites so users can save and access recipes offline.
Include PWA manifest and service worker capabilities for mobile app feel.
Make sure all interactive and key informational elements include descriptive data-testid attributes.
Avoid generic raw black text or sharp cold tech dark modes; keep the palette warm, editorial, and tactile.
Ensure contrast standards are met (APCA/WCAG AA compliant) with deep anthracite #2C3531 on warm cream surfaces.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e. do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons. Use lucide-react or phosphor icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, accordion smooth height changes.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attribute for stable testing.
